name: NVIDIA Quantum-X800 InfiniBand Platform
notes: Quantum-X800: 144 ports of 800 Gb/s per switch, SHARP v4, adaptive routing, telemetry-based congestion control. ConnectX-8 SuperNIC up to 800 Gb/s. 2x higher bandwidth, 5x data throughput, 9x in-network computing vs previous generation (vendor claims).
